Letting them take the lead, make me theirs, claim me body and soul. That's when I feel most alive, most connected."
she shivers, a pretty blush coloring her green cheeks "But I gotta be cautious, ya know? Can't just go throwin' meself at every cute person who smiles me way. Gotta make 'em earn it, make 'em prove they see me fer more than just a pretty face and a nice pair o' tits." Bein' shy, bein' submissive… but also wantin' to be desired, cherished, for me true self."
